priority.rationale: Complete and verify administrator control of email templates and notification triggers before connecting onboarding notifications to new user and member dashboards.

execution.objective: Complete and runtime-verify the admin notification-management workflow from multilingual template authoring through approved event triggering and auditable Resend delivery, reusing the existing authorized transport and canonical notification pipeline.
success_criteria: Preserve the existing admin template list, create, and update capabilities and verify them against the canonical template schema.
Verify server-side administrator authorization for every template-management and notification-management endpoint.
Validate template variables against approved event payload contracts and provide an administrator preview before activation.
Define safe template lifecycle behavior, including draft and active states and a reversible retirement/archive path; preserve historical delivery records.
Make the admin trigger matrix reflect canonical runtime configuration and evidence, not a manually maintained status label alone.
Connect approved notification intents to the existing Resend delivery stage and persist accurate sent, failed, and retryable outcomes without duplicate sends.
Provide administrators with auditable delivery status and actionable failure information without exposing secrets or private recipient data.
Preserve English, Vietnamese, and Chinese template content and define behavior when a requested locale is unavailable.
Reuse GE-RMP-014 transport and GEX-NOTIFY-001 intent/pipeline contracts; do not create parallel provider, template, intent, or delivery authorities.
Keep required transactional onboarding and security notifications independent of subscription or credit balance.
Do not enable premium campaigns or credit-funded user/member notification services; those remain a later WCS.
Founder runtime review verifies administrator authorization, template lifecycle, preview/validation, trigger accuracy, successful delivery, failure handling, and audit visibility.
Administrators can create, save, and send email templates in English only, Vietnamese only, Chinese only, English and Vietnamese, or English and Chinese.
AI suggests copy for each subject and message field in every selected language; suggestions require administrator review before save, activation, or send.
Bilingual dispatch behavior is explicit and does not silently duplicate emails.
Identify the approved AI service and data-use authority before implementation; recipient personal data is not sent to the AI service.
execution.verification_profile: WCS_SCHEMA_AND_JSON_VALIDATION; ADMIN_AUTHORIZATION_REVIEW; TEMPLATE_VARIABLE_AND_LIFECYCLE_REVIEW; TRIGGER_TO_RUNTIME_EVIDENCE; DELIVERY_FAILURE_AND_IDEMPOTENCY_REVIEW; RELEASE_GUARD; PRODUCTION_BUILD; FOUNDER_RUNTIME_REVIEW

depends_on: GE-RMP-014 — reuse and verify the existing Resend transport and preserved sendNotification()/sendEmail() contracts.
GEX-NOTIFY-001 — verify the canonical notification intent, template resolver, delivery projection, and provider-adapter contracts.
Existing server-side Google Gemini integration — verify credential handling and safe template-only inputs before implementation.
unlocks: WCS-APP-MEMBER-010 onboarding notification integration after admin notification management is runtime-verified.
A later WCS for subscription- or credit-enabled notification services, subject to explicit entitlement and consent rules.

portfolio_binding.sequencing_note: Complete and founder-verify this admin notification WCS before WCS-APP-MEMBER-010 wires onboarding messages into user/member dashboards. Paid notification services remain a later work cycle.

forbidden_surface: Runtime implementation before separate implementation authority approval
New notification provider, template, intent, or delivery authority

founder_runtime_test.test_definition: After implementation authority is approved and runtime is built, verify administrator access, template lifecycle, event trigger accuracy, successful delivery, and failure reporting/recovery.
founder_runtime_test.expected_outcome: Authorized administrators can manage approved templates and notification triggers; runtime delivery state is accurate; provider failures remain visible and do not create duplicate or false-success outcomes.

observed: English, Vietnamese, and Chinese subject/message fields
not_established_by_inspection: Whether status changes activate/deactivate templates at runtime

observed: Persistence methods for list, create, and update
not_established_by_inspection: Whether global middleware enforces administrator authorization on these routes
Template version immutability and uniqueness rules
Runtime validation of template variables against event payloads

trigger_matrix.observed: The displayed event matrix is embedded in the page and labels events LIVE or Planned.
trigger_matrix.gap: Verify each LIVE event against runtime evidence and ensure displayed statuses cannot drift from the actual trigger configuration.

observed: Persists one NotificationIntent with pending status
Does not invoke a provider adapter at this pipeline stage
notification_pipeline.gap: Verify the separate delivery projection/provider stage, Resend outcome persistence, failure reporting, and retry/idempotency behavior.

ai_assistance.languages: Every language selected for the template
ai_assistance.review_rule: Editable suggestions require explicit administrator review before saving, activation, or sending.
ai_assistance.privacy_rule: Do not send recipient personal data or private profile/contact details to the AI service.
ai_assistance.authority_gate: Founder approved Google Gemini for admin email-template drafting. Verify the existing server-side Gemini integration and credential handling before implementation; never expose credentials to the client.
ai_assistance.input_scope: Email template subject/message text and selected language only; no recipient personal data.

admin_email_authoring.bilingual_dispatch: Define whether paired languages are combined in one email or resolved by recipient preference; do not silently send duplicate emails.
